understood: Prompts are lightweight public/shareable lead magnets; skills are structured, versioned and testable capability packages that may be commercialized. Prompt Factory creates and tracks prompts; Skill Factory promotes proven prompts/workflows into skills. Git is the shared public-safe synchronization source and these capabilities do not create a new OOS core.
concerns: Private skill payload distribution and installation are not implemented yet; the current public skills catalog exposes metadata only.
cost_control: Use scope-first retrieval, metadata/index filtering, targeted reads, reuse prior evidence, and stop once required evidence is sufficient.
proposed_change: Require immutable release ref/hash metadata before a prompt or skill can move to published status.
